scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm test -w e2e --
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run test:ui -w e2e
